svg.title: Should I refactor this?
svg.desc: Should I refactor this?. I hate this code → Has tests?. Has tests? → Write tests first: no. Write tests first → Changing it soon?. Has tests? → Changing it soon?: yes. Changing it soon? → Leave it. It works.: no. Changing it soon? → Refactor in small steps: yes. Note on Refactor in small steps: one commit per move.
